description: This file defines the DefaultContentDefinitionDisplayManager class, which manages building and updating editors for content types, parts, and fields in OrchardCore CMS, utilizing display management, content management, and layout services.

classes.name: DefaultContentDefinitionDisplayManager
classes.description: Manages the display and editing of content type, part, and field definitions within OrchardCore, providing methods to build and update editors asynchronously.

methods.name: BuildTypeEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content type definition.

methods.name: UpdateTypeEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a content type definition.

methods.name: BuildPartEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content part definition.

methods.name: UpdatePartEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a content part definition.

methods.name: BuildTypePartEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content type part definition.

methods.name: UpdateTypePartEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a content type part definition.

methods.name: BuildPartFieldEditorAsync
methods.description: Builds the editor shape for a content part field definition.

methods.name: UpdatePartFieldEditorAsync
methods.description: Updates the editor shape for a content part field definition.
